summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly extension of its business combination deadline. On July 21, 2026, $50,000 was deposited into the trust account, extending the period to complete its initial business combination by one month to August 22, 2026. The fee was split equally between the sponsor and the target under the existing business combination agreement. The filing also notes a promissory note issued on July 30, 2026. This is a standard SPAC administrative update, not a special situation.
